visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men are standing outdoors in a theme park setting. One man has pink hair and is wearing a blue and white varsity-style jacket; he is gesturing towards a second man. The second man wears a brown quilted jacket and a blue bow headband, looking serious as if receiving instructions. The background shows trees, a white fence, and a themed building. (2) Five men stand in a row facing the camera. The man in the brown jacket is in the center. The others are wearing casual winter clothing like hoodies and jackets. A numeric countdown appears at the bottom of the screen. (3) The man in the brown jacket begins dancing with high energy, flapping his arms and moving his torso in a chicken-like manner. The other four men remain perfectly still, some covering their mouths or looking away to hide their smiles. (4) The man in the brown jacket continues his vigorous dance, moving forward and backward while the others stay stationary. He suddenly stops and turns around to look at his friends. (5) Upon seeing the group laughing at him, he realizes he was the only one dancing. He breaks into a smile and laughs along with them. The pink-haired man walks over and hugs him as the whole group gathers together, laughing and talking in the bright daylight.
